macros.name: Edge
macros.doc: Edges can be generated between one or two vertices.

macros.name: EdgesInBG
macros.doc: Per default edges are drawn on the background layer, with the command \EdgesNotInBG this can be disabled, while the command \EdgesInBG restores the default setting.

macros.name: EdgesNotInBG
macros.doc: Per default edges are drawn on the background layer, with the command \EdgesNotInBG this can be disabled, while the command \EdgesInBG restores the default setting.

macros.name: Plane
macros.doc: A \Plane is a rectangle with origin (⟨x⟩,⟨y⟩), a given ⟨width⟩ and ⟨height⟩.

macros.name: SetCoordinates
macros.doc: The perspective of the three-dimensional plot can be modified by changing the orientation of the coordinate system, which is done with the command \SetCoordinates.

macros.name: SetDistanceScale
macros.doc: With the command \SetDistanceScale, the distance between the vertices can be scaled.

macros.name: SetEdgeStyle
macros.doc: The appearance of the edges can be modified with the command \SetEdgeStyle.

macros.name: SetLayerDistance
macros.doc: With the command \SetLayerDistance the distance between the layers and their orientation can be modified.

macros.name: SetPlaneStyle
macros.doc: The appearance of the planes can be modified with the command \SetPlaneStyle.

macros.name: SetPlaneWidth
macros.doc: With the commands \SetPlaneWidth and \SetPlaneHeight the default size of the planes can be modified.

macros.name: SetTextStyle
macros.doc: The appearance of the text can be modified with the command \SetTextStyle.

macros.name: SetVertexStyle
macros.doc: The appearance of the vertices can be modified with the command \SetVertexStyle.

envs.name: Layer
envs.doc: Besides adding vertices and edges to specific layers, every other TikZ object can be drawn on such a layer using the Layer environment.
